description: ⚠ INDIRECTLY COSTS LLM CREDITS — approving the plan unfreezes the agent which then runs more planning + execution LLM calls. Manual approval required; do NOT call unless the user explicitly told you to advance their Aurora agent. Approve a semi-automated agent that is waiting in pending_plan_approval or pending_action_approval. Auto-detects which approval the agent needs and emits the matching state-machine event so the agent resumes execution. Returns 400 if the agent is not in a pending-approval state.
name: approve_agent_plan
